idea.statement: A scheduling tool that removes the back-and-forth of booking client calls for solo consultants.

claims.text: Consultants lose 3+ hours a week to booking back-and-forth.
claims.label: Observed

claims.text: The pain recurs every week for active consultants.
claims.label: Observed

claims.text: 9 of 12 said they would pay $20/mo to remove it.
claims.label: Observed

claims.text: Two consultant communities of 5k members each allow tool posts.
claims.label: Observed

claims.text: There are ~1.2M solo consultants in the target geography.
claims.label: Observed

claims.text: Incumbents target teams, not solos, and are priced for teams.
claims.label: Observed

claims.text: The current alternative is manual email, which everyone dislikes.
claims.label: Observed
